title: DR1 puts a 'Change number of animals' link on each species panel; the frontend gives a person no way to correct the count from the identification page.

finding.frontend: Each commodity line gets a plain heading — 'Cow (0102) — Bos taurus' — and immediately below it the entry counter and fields. A person who realises the count is wrong while entering the fourth of six animals has no link to correct it; the counter and the record cap are both driven by the number of animals answered earlier, and the only way back is the Back link. The card heading is rendered with no accompanying action at src/server/app/sets/live-animals/journeys/linear/features/commodities/animal-identification/_identification-card.njk:9-10.
finding.prototype: Every species panel in DR1 opens with a header bar carrying the species name on the left and a 'Change number of animals' link on the right, going to /consignment-details where the count was set (app/views/animal-identification-details.html:93-98). The link is on every panel, so on a multi-species consignment the person changes the count for the species they are looking at.
finding.difference: Add a link beside each card heading that returns to the consignment-details page where numberOfAnimals for that commodity line is answered, carrying the change context so the person comes back to the identification page. Worth doing after the Selected commodities block, because that block already carries the count per line and the two together are what makes the page correctable.
finding.falsifiedBy: Finding a link on the frontend's identification card that returns to the number-of-animals answer, or a DR1 species panel rendered without the change-count link.

relatedTo.why: both restore a route out of the identification page back to the commodity answers
